name: Vlad
source:
Vlad is an employee of "Pomidorochka" supermarket branch, where Slava gets a job; the most mature and experienced of all the employees of the sales floor. He tries to interact with colleagues as little as possible; enjoys the respect of Nikolai Mikhailovich and the reputation of a "professional."

He avoids talking about personal topics, but once told me that he studied at the Faculty of Physics and Mathematics until he was expelled for not attending.

It is also known that he successfully participated in many chess tournaments until the end of high school.
